preconditions.description: The input string S has a length of at most 40 characters.

preconditions.expression: S.count('@') == 1 or all(c.isdigit() or c in {'+', '-', '(', ')', ' '} for c in S)
preconditions.description: The input string S is either a valid email address (contains exactly one '@') or a valid phone number (contains only digits, '+', '-', '(', ')', or ' ').

preconditions.expression: S.count('@') == 1 and len(S) >= 8 or all(c.isdigit() or c in {'+', '-', '(', ')', ' '} for c in S) and len(S) >= 10
preconditions.description: If S is an email, its length is at least 8; if S is a phone number, its length is at least 10.

postconditions.expression: S.count('@') == 1 and (lambda s: (lambda name1, name2, name3: f"{name1[0]}{'*'*max(0, len(name1)-2)}{name1[-1]}@{name2.lower()}.{name3.lower()}")(*(s.split('@') + [s.split('@')[1].split('.')[1], s.split('@')[1].split('.')[2]])))(S) == return_value
postconditions.description: If S is an email, the output is the masked email where the first name is converted to lowercase, the letters between the first and last letter of the first name are replaced by 5 asterisks, and the rest of the email is in lowercase.

postconditions.expression: S.count('@') == 0 and (lambda s: (lambda digits: f"{'+' if len(digits) > 10 else ''}{'*'*(len(digits)-10) if len(digits) > 10 else ''}***-***-{digits[-4:]}")(''.join(c for c in s if c.isdigit())))(S) == return_value
postconditions.description: If S is a phone number, the output is the masked phone number where only the last 4 digits are exposed, formatted as '***-***-1111', and the country code (if present) is masked with asterisks, preserving the '+' sign if it exists.
